name: Simulacrum

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: powdered ruby worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: the beast or humanoid to copy, within 10 feet of you for the whole casting

summary: Make an obedient snow-and-ice duplicate of a Beast or Humanoid with half its Hit Point maximum.
text: The copy uses the original's statistics but is a Construct, can't cast this spell, gain levels or rest, and acts on your turn. It heals only through repairs during your Long Rest costing 100 GP per Hit Point, melts at 0 Hit Points, and is destroyed if you cast the spell again.
